comment: Lane-Emden 3D Hydrostatic Test with Self-Gravity - ~200k particles (N=100) PRODUCTION
description: High-resolution hydrostatic equilibrium test after relaxation. Tests stability over multiple crossing times (>> tidal disruption timescale). Production quality with 200k particles.
_comment_tidal_time: For IMBH: M_BH/M_cloud = 10^5/10^4 = 10, so t_tidal ~ sqrt(10) * t_dyn ~ 3.16
_comment_scattering_time: t_scatter ~ b/v_rel. For b=3pc, v=10km/s: t_scatter ~ 0.3Myr ~ 0.3 code units
_comment_output_freq: outputTime = 0.2 ~ 5 snapshots per crossing time (50 total snapshots)
_comment_resolution: N=100 → 200,000 particles ensures N_J > 50-100 particles per Jeans mass
